Initial release of Generation to Generator — Turn Text Into Generated Videos:

- Instantly turn text prompts or scripts into AI-generated videos with visuals and music.

- Automatic setup with anonymous tokens for quick access; no manual authentication required.
- Offers cloud-powered 1080p MP4 video rendering with a simple prompt-driven workflow.
- Built-in actions for uploading files, checking credits, exporting videos, and managing session state.
- Optimized for marketers and creators wanting fast, no-filming-required video generation from written content.
